grc:name:Ἶρος.html:
Ἶρος, ὁ, Irus, a name given by the suitors to the Ithacan beggar Arnaeus because he carried messages (cf. Ἶρις), sq.: hence, later as Appellat.,
an Irus, i.e. a beggar, : pl., Ἶροι.
